evaluations.expected_answer: Applicants must be 21 to 60 years old at application and no older than 65 at maturity.

retrieved_sources.title: Personal Loan Policy (Aurora FlexiCash)
retrieved_sources.passage: Self-employed professionals and business owners must be between 25 and 65 years of age, have at least 3 years of business continuity, file Income Tax Returns for the last 2 years, and have a minimum annual income of ₹6,00,000 as per ITR. retrieved_sources.passage:
- Age: 21 years to 60 years at the time of application, and not more than 65 years at loan maturity.
- Minimum net monthly income: ₹25,000 for applicants living in metro cities and ₹20,000 for other locations.

evaluations.question: How do I report an unauthorized transaction?
evaluations.expected_answer: Report it through the app, net banking, or the 24x7 helpline 1800-120-4567.

retrieved_sources.title: Digital Banking, Security and Grievance Redressal Policy
retrieved_sources.passage:
Customers must report an unauthorised transaction as soon as they notice it, through the app, net banking, or by calling the 24x7 helpline 1800-120-4567.
| When reported | Customer liability |
|---|---|
| Within 3 working days of receiving the alert | Zero liability for third-party frauds |
| Between 4 and 7 working days | Limited liability of ₹5,000 for savings accounts and up to ₹25,000 for current accounts and cards with higher limits |
| After 7 working days | As per the bank board-approved policy |
The bank credits the disputed amount to the customer account within 10 working days of the report, after which the investigation continues.

evaluations.observed_output:
You can report an unauthorized transaction through the app, net‑banking, or by calling the 24‑hour helpline 1800‑120‑4567. [1]

- Report it as soon as you notice the transaction to qualify for zero liability for third‑party frauds. [1]  
- If reported within 3 working days of the alert, you have no liability. [1]  
- Reporting between 4 and 7 working days limits liability to ₹5,000 for savings accounts and up to ₹25,000 for current accounts and cards with higher limits. [1]  
- After 7 working days, liability follows the bank’s board‑approved policy. [1]  
- The bank will credit the disputed amount to your account within 10 working days of the report, while the investigation continues. [1]
